description: AAASM-5345: the documentation SSN of pii_ssn.json written in full-width digits with ASCII separators is detected as the same kind. This is the mixed-width span the offset arithmetic is least likely to survive — 3-byte digits interleaved with 1-byte hyphens — and the exact-11-byte SSN shape check has to run against the normalised digits while the reported span stays in original-text bytes.
